entities.name: Syr Armont
entities.description: Human knight captain from Ardenvale, kind and devoted, who broke the werefox curse at Redtooth Keep.

entities.name: Yenna
entities.description: Leader of the werefoxes who told Armont of the rose and fell for her.

entities.name: Redtooth Keep
entities.description: Keep where an ancient elf bloodline lived, cursed to become werefoxes.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane where Armont is a knight.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Armont sought to heal the Realm.

entities.name: Werefoxes
entities.description: Elves cursed to transform into werefoxes at night.

events.summary: Armont journeys into the Wilds with her knights and finds Redtooth Keep, whose elves are cursed to become werefoxes.
events.quote: In the forest she stumbled upon Redtooth Keep

events.summary: Armont and Yenna find the enchanted rose in a glade and Armont breaks the curse.
events.quote: the knight was able to break the curse

relations.note: Implied to have fallen in love
relations.quote: It is implied the two fell in love.
